FIELDS.NAME: Active Life Recreation Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Active Life Recreation Center is dedicated to promoting health and wellness through various recreational activities within a safe and controlled environment. Our facility includes well-maintained amenities such as swimming pools, tennis courts, and a gym, providing a diverse range of activities for individuals and families. We prioritize safety by implementing comprehensive training programs for our staff, ensuring they are equipped to respond effectively to emergencies. While we do not provide on-site food or alcohol service, we maintain strict security measures, including controlled access and surveillance systems to ensure the safety of all patrons. Our operations are underpinned by robust financial management practices, allowing us to sustainably support our community-centered programs and events. Regular maintenance protocols are adhered to, ensuring a high standard of facility upkeep, and we diligently evaluate all sponsored activities to identify and mitigate potential liability exposures.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2022, during a scheduled maintenance check, we discovered water damage in the gym due to a leaky roof. The repair costs amounted to $3,500. The damage has been fully remediated, and the roof has been repaired. The status of the loss is closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and monitored access control systems
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The facility focuses on recreational activities and maintains a safe environment.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not sponsor athletic teams, as our focus is primarily on providing a safe environment for recreational activities and promoting health and wellness.

FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years at the Active Life Recreation Center.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not lease employees to or from other employers and handles all staffing directly to ensure consistent operations and service quality.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not currently have any Workers' Compensation coverage in place, but it is compliant with regulations regarding this matter.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on providing recreational services at this facility.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The Active Life Recreation Center currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The Active Life Recreation Center is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on providing recreational activities and maintaining a safe environment for our patrons.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is solely on providing recreational services within our facility.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as it primarily focuses on recreational activities in a safe and controlled environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The Active Life Recreation Center does not have any catastrophe exposure as its operations focus on recreational activities in a safe and controlled environment without significant risks associated with catastrophes.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at the Active Life Recreation Center. The facility prioritizes safety and compliance in all operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – The Active Life Recreation Center has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with fire safety regulations. Regular inspections are conducted to ensure ongoing adherence to necessary codes.
